name: Dhaka
delicacy: Dhakaiya Biryani, Bakarkhani, Morog Polao
heritage: Mughal Capital Jahangirnagar (1610), 1952 Language Movement, 1971 Independence Proclamation at Historic Suhrawardy Udyan.
touristTips: Explore Old Dhaka heritage trails on a rickshaw, visit Sadarghat launch terminal at sunset, and taste authentic saffron biryani.

name: Gazipur
delicacy: Jackfruit (National Fruit of Bangladesh), Traditional Pitha
heritage: Historic Bhawal Estate and famous Sannyasi case; premier research institutions and digital industrial hub.
touristTips: Visit Bangabandhu Safari Park for open safari jeep rides and Bhawal Sal forest for eco-resort retreats.

name: Narayanganj
delicacy: Sonargaon Jamdani Weave Heritage Sweets, Jhal Chhola
heritage: Ancient medieval capital of Bengal under Isa Khan; world capital of UNESCO-inscribed Jamdani handloom.
touristTips: Walk through the eerie 19th-century deserted colonial mansions of Panam City and visit Shilpacharya Zainul Abedin Folk Art Museum.

name: Tangail
delicacy: Porabarir Chamcham (King of Sweets), Tangail Taant Cotton Shari
heritage: Birthplace of historic Tangail Taant weaving and authentic 1608 Atiya Mosque depicted on 10 Taka note.
touristTips: Tour Mohera Zamindar Palace heritage resort and buy genuine GI-tagged Tangail handloom cotton saris from local weavers.

name: Munshiganj (Bikrampur)
delicacy: Bikrampuri Sweet Curd, Mawa Ghat Fresh Fried Ilish with Mustard & Green Chilies
heritage: Ancient capital of Bikrampur Kings; birthplace of Buddhist master Atish Dipankar and scientist Sir Jagadish Chandra Bose.
touristTips: Drive across the Mawa expressway to enjoy fresh sizzling Padma Ilish fish fries right at the river pier.

name: Narsingdi
delicacy: Amriti Sweet, Sagar Kola (Banana), Lal Teer Vegetables
heritage: Wari-Bateshwar, ancient 6th century BCE urban civilization trading across the Indian Ocean.
touristTips: Discover ancient silver punch-marked coins and Roman glass beads at Wari-Bateshwar excavation center.

name: Manikganj
delicacy: Hajar Gur (Legendary Date Palm Jaggery), Makhan Peda
heritage: Baliati Palace is one of the grandest 19th-century zamindar estates in South Asia with 200+ ornate rooms.
touristTips: Marvel at the seven colossal buildings and ionic columns of Baliati Palace in Saturia.

name: Faridpur
delicacy: Khejurer Gur (Date Palm Syrup), Sandesh
heritage: Homeland of National Rural Poet Jasimuddin (author of Nakshi Kanthar Math); historic Faraizi movement.
touristTips: Visit Jasimuddin folk museum on the banks of Kumar river in Ambikapur during annual Poush mela.

name: Gopalganj
delicacy: Mattha, Rosogolla, Chhana Sweets
heritage: Sacred birthplace and eternal resting place of the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
touristTips: Pay respects at the tranquil red-brick and white marble Bangabandhu Mausoleum Complex in Tungipara.

name: Madaripur
delicacy: Kashmiri Sweet, Khejur Patali Gur
heritage: Named after Sufi Saint Badiuddin Zinda Shah Madar; key hub during anti-British Faraizi resistance led by Haji Shariatullah.
touristTips: Stroll around the scenic Shakuni Lake walkway in the heart of Madaripur town.

name: Rajbari
delicacy: Rajbari Chamcham, Padma River Hilsa
heritage: Homeland of legendary novelist Mir Mosharraf Hossain, author of timeless masterpiece Bishad Shindhu.
touristTips: Visit Mir Mosharraf Hossain auditorium and memorial library in Padamdi.

name: Shariatpur
delicacy: Hilsa from Kirtinasha, Date Jaggery Sandesh
heritage: Named in honor of Haji Shariatullah, pioneer of 19th-century socio-religious Faraizi renaissance.
touristTips: Experience the modern mega expressway connecting Janjira directly with Padma Bridge.

name: Kishoreganj
delicacy: Haor Fresh Baim & Boal Fish, Kishorganj Balish Mishti (Pillow Sweet)
heritage: Birthplace of Chandravati (Bengali literature first woman poet) and Satyajit Ray grandfather Upendrakishore Ray Chowdhury.
touristTips: Rent a traditional engine boat on Nikli Haor during monsoon to feel like cruising on an endless ocean.

name: Chattogram
delicacy: Mezban Beef Gosht, Kala Bhuna, Chonakatha Shutki Bhorta
heritage: Historic 1930 Chittagong Armoury Raid led by Masterda Surya Sen; sacred Halda River (only natural carp breeding river).
touristTips: Drive through South Asia first underwater river tunnel and enjoy red sunset with crab fry at Patenga beach.

name: Cox's Bazar
delicacy: Fresh Coral & Red Snapper BBQ, Loitta Fry, Dried Fish (Shutki), Rupchanda Fish Curry
heritage: World longest unbroken natural sandy beach stretching 120 km; ancient Rakhine Buddhist pagodas in Ramu.
touristTips: Ride an open-top Jeep down the spectacular Marine Drive highway between crashing ocean waves and emerald green mountains.

name: Rangamati
delicacy: Bamboo Chicken, Hebaang (Fish Steamed in Banana Leaf), Pajon Curry
heritage: Spiritual heart of Chakma royalty and indigenous communities; largest artificial freshwater lake in South Asia.
touristTips: Hire a long-tail boat to navigate through Shuvolong gorge and buy indigenous handmade pinon-hadi fabrics.

name: Bandarban
delicacy: Mundhi Indigenous Noodles, Bamboo Shoot Delicacy, Sangu River Mountain Fish
heritage: Home to 11 diverse ethnic communities (Marma, Bawm, Mro, Tripura, etc.) and Bangladesh highest mountain peaks.
touristTips: Experience trekking to turquoise crater Boga Lake and sunrise over sea of clouds from Nilgiri top.

name: Khagrachhari
delicacy: Sabrang Herb Curry, Bamboo Shoot Stir-Fry, Wild Forest Honey
heritage: Traditional Marma and Tripura folk culture; ancient natural limestone sub-terrestrial caves at Alutila.
touristTips: Walk through the dark limestone Alutila Cave holding a flaming bamboo torch for an adrenaline thrill.

name: Cumilla
delicacy: Matri Bhandar Genuine Rasmalai, Khadi Cotton Clothing
heritage: 8th-century archaeological center of Buddhist Deva and Chandra dynasties; birthplace of world-renowned hand-spun Khadi cloth.
touristTips: Buy original Rasmalai directly from historic Matri Bhandar shop at Manoharpur in Cumilla town.

name: Feni
delicacy: Feni Mahish Curd (Buffalo Yogurt), Khandaler Mishti
heritage: Muhuri Project is Bangladesh second largest irrigation project and winter habitat for migratory birds.
touristTips: Watch sunset where Muhuri and Feni rivers meet the Bay of Bengal estuary.

name: Brahmanbaria
delicacy: Chhanar Mukhi Sweet (GI Tagged), Titas River Hilsa
heritage: Cultural capital of classical music; ancestral land of Sarod maestro Ustad Alauddin Khan and epic novel Titash Ekti Nadir Naam.
touristTips: Taste authentic melt-in-mouth GI-certified Chhanar Mukhi sweets.

name: Noakhali
delicacy: Narkel Naru, Chital Fish Kofta, Ghol & Buffalo Curd
heritage: Mahatma Gandhi peace mission at Joyag during 1946; Nijhum Dwip island home to 40,000+ spotted spotted deer.
touristTips: Take a boat to Nijhum Dwip to watch herds of wild spotted deer grazing against mangrove forest margins.

name: Lakshmipur
delicacy: Moish Doi (Buffalo Milk Curd), Supera & Paan
heritage: Major hub of coastal fish landing, coconut orchards, and fertile alluvial farmland along the Lower Meghna estuary.
touristTips: Experience traditional fishing boats pulling ashore fresh sparkling silver Hilsa at Motirhat.

name: Chandpur
delicacy: Chandpur Padma-Meghna Hilsa (Ilish Capital of Bangladesh), One-Minute Mishti
heritage: Tri-river confluence where the mighty Padma, Meghna, and Dakatia merge together; known globally as the Hilsa Capital.
touristTips: Visit Mollah Head point at sunset to observe two distinct river water colors mixing together.

name: Rajshahi
delicacy: Rajshahi Silk, Himsagar & Langra Mangoes, Kalojam
heritage: Capital of ancient Varendra civilization; global pioneer of mulberry silk weaving and cleanest green city in Bangladesh.
touristTips: Stroll along the paved Padma T-Groin embankment at dusk and visit the Varendra research antiquities.

name: Bogura
delicacy: Bogra Bogurar Doi (World Famous Sweet Curd), Kotkoti
heritage: Pundranagar at Mahasthangarh is the earliest fortified urban city site excavated in Bangladesh history.
touristTips: Climb the ancient ramparts of Mahasthangarh citadel and savor thick baked red curd from Gourogopal or Asian Sweet.

name: Pabna
delicacy: Pabna Pure Ghee, Peda, Chhanar Jilapi
heritage: Century-old railway steel truss engineering marvel Hardinge Bridge (1915); home to Bangladesh first nuclear energy plant.
touristTips: Admire the architectural juxtaposition of historic 1915 Hardinge Bridge and modern Lalon Shah Highway Bridge over the Padma.

name: Sirajganj
delicacy: Sirajganj Milk Sweets, Dhaner Shish Doi, Handloom Cotton Gamchha & Lungi
heritage: Rabindranath Tagore spent years at Shahzadpur Kachharibari writing iconic poems like Sonar Tari and Postmaster.
touristTips: Tour the serene Tagore memorial palace at Shahzadpur and admire the 9-towered Navaratna terracotta temple.

name: Natore
delicacy: Natore Kachagolla (GI Tagged King of Sweet Chhana)
heritage: Historic capital of Maharani Bhabani who ruled Bengal during 18th century; grand Italian-styled Uttara Ganabhaban palace.
touristTips: Walk through the 41-acre royal gardens and deer enclosures of Uttara Ganabhaban and taste fresh warm Kachagolla.

name: Naogaon
landmarks: Somapura Mahavihara at Paharpur (UNESCO World Heritage)
delicacy: Pera Sandesh, Fragrant Chinigura Aromatic Rice
heritage: 8th-century Somapura Mahavihara built by King Dharmapala is the largest Buddhist vihara south of the Himalayas.
touristTips: Spend a quiet afternoon exploring the massive central stupa and terracotta plaques of Paharpur UNESCO heritage site.

name: Chapai Nawabganj
delicacy: Fazli & Ashwina Mangoes, Shivganjer Chomchom, Kalaikari Ruti with Duck Curry
heritage: Medieval Sultanate capital of Gaur situated along the western frontier; undisputed Mango Capital of Bangladesh.
touristTips: Visit the 15-domed black stone Choto Sona Mosque and taste roasted Kalai ruti with spicy duck curry.

name: Joypurhat
delicacy: Joypurhat Sugar & Sugarcane Gur, Chhoto Jamunar Fish
heritage: Ancient sugar hub and limestone deposits; Hinda Kasba mosque featuring pristine white Persian domes.
touristTips: Tour the picturesque floral domes of Hinda-Kasba mosque and ancient Nandail water reservoir.

name: Khulna
delicacy: Chui Jhal Spicy Beef & Mutton, Sundarbans Raw Wild Honey, Tiger Prawns (Galda Chingri)
heritage: Southern industrial capital; gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage Sundarbans Mangrove Reserve.
touristTips: Dine at Khulnas famous Abbas Hotel or Chuknagar to taste authentic slow-cooked Chui Jhal spicy beef.

name: Jashore
delicacy: Jashore Khejur Gur (Date Palm Jaggery Patali), Jamtolar Sweet
heritage: First district of Bangladesh to be liberated from Pakistani occupation on December 7, 1971; birthplace of epic poet Madhusudan Dutt.
touristTips: Visit Gadkhali early morning to see millions of freshly plucked roses, gerberas, and orchids being traded in color markets.

name: Bagerhat
landmarks: Shrine of Khan Jahan Ali (Dighi with sacred crocodiles)
delicacy: Shrimp Curry (Bagda Chingri), Bagerhat Coconut Pitha
heritage: 15th-century Khalifatabad mosque city founded by Sufi general Khan Jahan Ali, inscribed by UNESCO as World Heritage.
touristTips: Marvel at the 77 low brick domes of Sixty Dome Mosque and observe the legendary marsh crocodiles of Khan Jahan Ali Dighi.

name: Satkhira
delicacy: Satkhirar Sandesh & Pure Ghee, Sundarbans Khalsi Honey, Tiger Shrimp
heritage: Historic kingdom of Maharaja Pratapaditya of Bengal Baro Bhuiyans; home to Sundarbans western deep jungle creeks.
touristTips: Take a boat cruise into the Sundarbans forest canopy from Munshiganj Satkhira gateway.

name: Kushtia
delicacy: Tiler Khaja (Sesame Crunch Sweet), Kulfi Malai
heritage: Cultural heart of Baul philosophy and mystic saint Fakir Lalon Shah; Tagore composed many Nobel-winning Gitanjali verses here.
touristTips: Attend the mystical Lalon Dol Purnima music festival in Chheuriya where thousands of Bauls perform all night.

name: Jhenaidah
delicacy: Jhenaidah Banana, Peda, Khejur Gur
heritage: Land of folk mystic lyricist Pagla Kanai and mathematician Kazi Motahar Hossain; historic indigo resistance movements.
touristTips: Admire the centuries-old African Baobab tree and the ruins of Naldanga Temple complex.

name: Magura
delicacy: Magurar Sandesh, Sweet Curd, Madhumati Fresh Water Fish
heritage: Homeland of world-renowned all-rounder cricketer Shakib Al Hasan; historic kingdom of Raja Sitaram Ray.
touristTips: Tour the ancient terracotta Siddheswari temple in Mohammadpur alongside the Gorai river.

name: Chuadanga
landmarks: Carew & Co. Historic Distillery & Sugar Mills (1938)
delicacy: Chhana Sweets, Pure Cane Sugar Jaggery, Mathabhanga Fish
heritage: Carew & Co established in 1938 is the oldest organic distillery in the subcontinent; historic first provisional capital of 1971.
touristTips: Tour the grand industrial heritage architecture of Carew & Co compound in Darshana.

name: Meherpur
landmarks: Mujibnagar Memorial Complex (Birthplace of Bangladesh Government)
delicacy: Meherpur Sabri Banana, Kalo Jamun, Sweet Mangoes
heritage: On April 17, 1971, the first government of Independent Bangladesh took oath at Baidyanathtala (now Mujibnagar).
touristTips: Explore the 23-pillar Mujibnagar Monument representing 23 years of Pakistani struggle, with life-size historic war dioramas.

name: Narail
landmarks: SM Sultan Bengal Charit Art Gallery & House
delicacy: Chitra River Crab, Milk Sandesh, Narail Pitha
heritage: Birthplace of globally acclaimed master painter SM Sultan, whose gigantic canvases captured the strength of Bengali peasantry.
touristTips: Visit SM Sultan Memorial Gallery on the Chitra riverbank to see his original massive oil paintings and preserved boat Shishu Swarga.

name: Sylhet
delicacy: Sylheti Shatkora Beef, Nunor Bora, Bakarkhani, Fresh Assam-Ceylon Black Tea
heritage: 1303 arrival of Sufi saint Hazrat Shah Jalal (R.); spiritual gateway of South Asia and highest remittance-earning region.
touristTips: Take a serene country boat into the submerged mangrove-like canopy of Ratargul Freshwater Swamp Forest.

name: Moulvibazar
delicacy: Nilkantha Seven Layer Tea, Manipuri Pitha, Pineapples
heritage: Produces 75%+ of Bangladesh tea; pristine evergreen rainforests with endangered wildlife at Lawachara.
touristTips: Taste world-famous 7-colored multi-layered tea at Nilkantha Tea Cabin and trek through Lawachara jungle canopy.

name: Habiganj
delicacy: Haor Boro Fish Curry, Handloom Manipuri Shawls
heritage: Baniachong holds the distinction of being the largest village in Asia; Rema-Kalenga is the second largest natural forest in Bangladesh.
touristTips: Walk the tree canopy trail inside Satchari National Park to spot rare birds and capped langurs.

name: Sunamganj
delicacy: Freshwater Haor Fish (Airh, Chital, Baim), Sunamganjer Sandesh
heritage: Homeland of mystic philosopher songwriter Hason Raja and Baul king Shah Abdul Karim; Tanguar Haor is a global Ramsar biodiversity wetland.
touristTips: Book a luxury wooden houseboat on Tanguar Haor for overnight starlight cruising and swim in turquoise Jadukata river.

name: Barishal
delicacy: Ilish Fish Mustard Jhol, Balam Rice, Sweet Amra (Hog Plum), Gournadir Doi
heritage: Referred to historically as the Venice of Bengal; homeland of poet Jibanananda Das (author of Banalata Sen) and Sher-e-Bangla A.K. Fazlul Huq.
touristTips: Embark on an iconic multi-deck overnight launch journey from Dhaka to Barishal across the illuminated river highways.

name: Bhola
delicacy: Bhola Buffalo Milk Curd (Moish Doi), Meghna Coastal Hilsa, Fresh Coconut
heritage: The only island district of Bangladesh and largest offshore delta island; blessed with colossal natural gas reserves.
touristTips: Ride the high-speed glass elevator of 225-foot Jacob Tower to overlook the vast green island landscapes and sea channels.

name: Patuakhali
delicacy: Crab Curry, Coral Fish Fry, Coconut Water, Pitha
heritage: Kuakata offers the rare panoramic spectacle of watching both sunrise and sunset over the sparkling Bay of Bengal from the same beach spot.
touristTips: Wake up before dawn to watch the sunrise at Gangamati point and rent a beach bike along the 18 km sand stretch.

name: Pirojpur
delicacy: Sweet Guava, Amra, Sandhya River Prawns
heritage: Pioneered century-old riverine agricultural canal networks and nursery trading throughout Bangladesh.
touristTips: Take a country dinghy boat tour through water canals shaded under lush fruit orchards during monsoon.

name: Barguna
delicacy: Fresh Coastal Dried Fish, Bagda Shrimp, Coconut Treats
heritage: Ancient coastal outpost safeguarding southwestern estuaries; pristine mangrove wildlife sanctuary at Haringhata.
touristTips: Visit Shuvo Shondha beach where Payra river meets the open sea bordered by thick green Casuarina forests.

name: Jhalokati
delicacy: Shital Pati (Cooling Cane Mats), Jhalokati Sweet Doi, Guava Juice
heritage: Gabkhan channel is an artificial 18-km river canal built during British era to connect coastal waterway navigation.
touristTips: Watch huge cargo steamers navigate through the high-span Gabkhan bridge channel.

name: Rangpur
delicacy: Haribhanga Sweet Mango, Rangpur Shatranji Handloom Rugs (GI Tagged), Pitha
heritage: Royal palace of Maharaja Jagadindra Roy; legendary Shatranji woven carpet craft dating back to Mughal emperor Akbar era.
touristTips: Marvel at the marble staircase and colonial chandeliers of Tajhat Palace and Carmichael College red-brick campus.

name: Dinajpur
delicacy: Bedana & Madraji Litchi, Fragrant Kataribhog Rice, Papri Sweet
heritage: 1752 Kantaji Temple is the most spectacular terracotta Hindu temple in South Asia, decorated with Ramayana illustrations.
touristTips: Visit Kantaji Temple during sunset to capture the fiery golden glow of its thousands of terracotta relief carvings.

name: Panchagarh
delicacy: Panchagarh Plainland Organic Tea, River Stone Trout Fish
heritage: Northernmost tip of Bangladesh; only spot in Bangladesh where Himalayan peak Mt. Kanchenjunga can be viewed with naked eyes.
touristTips: Visit Tetulia Dak Bungalow in autumn (October-November) on a clear dawn to witness the majestic snow-capped Kanchenjunga.

name: Thakurgaon
delicacy: Suryapuri Mango, Peda Sweet, River Fish
heritage: The legendary Suryapuri mango tree at Baliadangi spans over 2 bighas with 19 major root branches.
touristTips: Stand under the colossal umbrella shade of the 200-year-old Baliadangi ancient heritage mango tree.

name: Nilphamari
delicacy: Teesta Fish, Chini Mosque Sweets, Kataribhog Chira
heritage: Saidpur Railway Workshop is the largest and oldest railway repair facility in Bengal established in 1870.
touristTips: Tour the dazzling China-porcelain tiled Chini Mosque in Saidpur with 27 minarets.

name: Kurigram
delicacy: Brahmaputra River Boal Fish, Kheer Chomchom, Chilmari Pitha
heritage: Immortalized in legendary folk songs such as Oki Gariyal Bhai on the historic Chilmari river ghat.
touristTips: Take a boat trip across the wide expanse of the Brahmaputra River during golden hour.

name: Lalmonirhat
delicacy: Corn Dishes, Teesta Fresh Fish, Sweet Sandesh
heritage: Strategic enclave corridor Tin Bigha; heritage railway junction connecting pre-partition Assam-Bengal rail routes.
touristTips: Visit the historic Tin Bigha Corridor and Burimari border landscape.

name: Gaibandha
delicacy: Gaibandhar Roshmonjuri (Signature Reduced Milk Sweet), River Ilish
heritage: Pioneered river char community development and world-famous Roshmonjuri milk sweet craft.
touristTips: Taste authentic hot Roshmonjuri sweet prepared in earthen pans in Gaibandha town.

name: Mymensingh
delicacy: Muktagachar Monda (200-year-old Ramgopal Sweet), Malaikari, Fresh Brahmaputra River Fish
heritage: Maimansingha Gitika medieval folk ballads compiled by Dinesh Chandra Sen; premier agricultural science research in Asia.
touristTips: Taste authentic GI-famed Monda at Muktagacha Gopal Pal heritage shop and stroll through Shashi Lodge Venus marble gardens.

name: Jamalpur
delicacy: Milir Pitha, Jamalpur Nakshi Pitha, Chhanar Polao Sweet
heritage: World famous artisan hub of intricate Nakshi Kantha hand-embroidered quilts and mustard oil.
touristTips: Visit rural artisan cooperatives in Islampur to see women craft exquisite Nakshi Kantha needlework.

name: Netrokona
delicacy: Balish Mishti of Goyanath (Pillow Sweet), Haor Fish, Someshwari Mahseer
heritage: Land of Baul songs and Hajong tribal revolution lead by Comrade Moni Singh; turquoise mineral lakes at Birishiri.
touristTips: Ride an engine boat on crystal clear Someshwari River and photograph the turquoise water of Ceramic White Clay Lake in Durgapur.

name: Sherpur
delicacy: Chhana Sandesh, Wild Garo Honey, Sticky Fragrant Biruin Rice
heritage: Bordered by lush Meghalaya hills with rich Koch and Garo indigenous customs; historical kingdom of Sher Ali Ghazi.
touristTips: Climb the watchtower at Madhutila Eco Park for a panoramic view of the rolling green Garo Hills along the border.
